harlech_guide.text: Welcome to Harlech Castle. Edward I built it between 1282 and 1289 on a cliff, with walls meant to be unbeatable.
It once had a water gate so ships could reach it from the sea. The sea has since backed away and left the castle to enjoy the view.
In the Wars of the Roses it held out for seven years, the longest siege in British history. The song Men of Harlech is said to remember it.

harlech_harpist.text: I play Men of Harlech all day. It is the only tune the walls like. The rest, they have heard before.
